from executor.code_assistant import code_health
from executor.app_factory_v2 import app_factory_status
from executor.android_control import android_safe_commands

print("code health keys:", code_health().keys())
print("app factory:", app_factory_status().keys())
print("android safe:", android_safe_commands())

client = app.test_client()

for path in [
    "/remote/code/health",
    "/remote/code/advice",
    "/remote/app-factory/status",
    "/remote/android/status",
    "/remote/android/safe-commands",
    "/remote/status"
]:
    r = client.get(path)
    print(path, r.status_code, "json" if r.is_json else "html")

for path, payload in [
    ("/remote/research/query", {"query": "Python Flask tutorial", "learn": False}),
    ("/remote/browser/read", {"url": "https://example.com", "learn": False}),
    ("/remote/app-factory/create", {"idea": "test app"}),
    ("/remote/android/notify", {"message": "test"})
]:
    r = client.post(path, json=payload)
    print(path, "without token:", r.status_code, r.get_json())
